g1.label: 1. Ten provinces and three ___
g1.why: The text says Canada has ten provinces and three territories.

g2.label: 2. From the age of ___
g2.why: The text says children must attend school from the age of six.

g3.label: 3. Free ___ schools
g3.why: The text says most Canadian students go to free public schools.

g4.label: 4. Officially ___
g4.why: The text says Canada is officially bilingual (English and French).

g5.label: 5. Wear a ___
g5.why: The text says public school students usually do not have to wear a uniform.

g6.label: 6. Starts at half past ___
g6.why: The text says a typical school day starts at half past eight.

g7.label: 7. Music, cooking or ___
g7.why: The text names music, cooking and computer science as options.

g8.label: 8. September to ___
g8.why: The text says the school year runs from September to June.

g1.label: 1. Children ___ go to school
g1.why: A law = external obligation: 'have to' (here interchangeable with 'must').

g2.label: 2. ___ wear a uniform
g2.why: Uniforms are not required, so it is not necessary: 'don't have to'.

g3.label: 3. ___ be late for class
g3.why: Being late is not allowed — a prohibition takes 'mustn't'.

g4.label: 4. ___ learn in French
g4.why: Parents can choose, so French is not necessary: 'don't have to'.

g6.label: 6. Ill: ___ come to school
g6.why: Staying home is allowed, so coming is not necessary: 'don't have to'.

g7.label: 7. ___ use phones in the exam room

g8.label: 8. ___ stay until sixteen
g8.why: A legal obligation up to age sixteen: 'have to'.

g2.label: 2. ___ copy homework
g2.why: Advice against something: 'shouldn't' — it is unwise, not forbidden.

g3.label: 3. ___ ask the teacher
g3.why: Asking for help is good advice: 'should'.

g4.label: 4. ___ be on their phones all break
g4.why: The second half recommends the opposite, so: 'shouldn't'.

g6.label: 6. ___ start studying the night before
g6.why: Starting late is bad advice, so: 'shouldn't'.

g7.label: 7. Canada ___ welcomed students
g7.why: Review from 10c-discover-canada: present perfect with a singular subject — 'has'.

g8.label: 8. New students ___ worry
g8.why: 'Canadian schools are friendly' makes worry unnecessary: 'shouldn't'.
